authorship: Lean benchmark applications and generic interoperability wrappers authored for this suite.

binarytrees.lean.inspiration: Official Lean binary-trees benchmark; dynamic leaf serials prevent constant leaf/subtree sharing.

nbody.lean.reference: Existing suite N-body workload, standard initial conditions and pairwise update algorithm.

fasta.lean.reference: Existing suite FASTA workload, standard ALU/IUB/Homo sapiens input data and LCG.

other_applications.reference: Workload definitions in ../../benchmarks/ and independent bounded corpus in ../shared/bounded-corpus-v1/.
other_applications.implementation: Application algorithms remain in Lean; no benchmark-sized native helper.

generic_native_leaves.Regex.c: PCRE2 compile and single next-match result. Lean performs iteration, counts, replacements and assembly.
